days.details: No ride after the weekend long ride. Strength A, about 25 min: tick each exercise off on Today. Use a dumbbell or kettlebell, or bodyweight; stop 2 reps short of failure.
days.actual: 3.3 mi ride to the store. Strength A not done: moved to Wednesday.

days.details: 15 min easy, then 2 × 20 min at the top of Zone 3 with 5 min easy between. Seated, steady cadence 85–95.

Day off work. Ride first: conversational pace on a flat route, HR strap on, stretch it out if you feel good. Then Strength A (about 25 min, moved from Monday): tick each exercise off on Today. Stop 2 reps short of failure, since hills are tomorrow.
Warm up 20 min, then 5 × 3 min hard on a steady climb, roll back down to recover. Kennesaw prep. If the legs are heavy from Wednesday's squats, do 4 repeats instead of 5.
Strength B, about 20 min (moved from Wednesday so it isn't two sessions in one day). Add 30–40 min very easy on the bike only if the legs want it. Keep it light before Saturday's long ride.
55+ mi for the Eddington count. Eat every 45 min, drink a bottle an hour. Moved to Saturday so Sunday is a rain backup.
If Saturday rains out, ride the long ride today. Otherwise 45–60 min easy or off.
